subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding the Indian football season 2024-25 as per the AIFF calendar?

1.)The Durand Cup 2024, Asia's oldest football tournament, is scheduled between July 26 and August 31.

2.) The I-League 3 and the Junior Girls National Football Championship (Tier 1 & 2) will both run during the same calendar month.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Statement 1:** The **Durand Cup 2024**, Asia's oldest football tournament, is scheduled between **July 26** and **August 31, 2024**. This statement is *correct* as the All India Football Federation (AIFF) has officially announced the tournament's schedule in its calendar for the 2024-25 football season. The Durand Cup is one of India's most prestigious football tournaments. 
• **Statement 2:** The **I-League 3** and the **Junior Girls National Football Championship** (Tier 1 & 2) will both run during the same calendar month. This statement is *incorrect* as per the AIFF calendar for the 2024-25 season. These tournaments are scheduled in different months to avoid overlap and ensure smooth organization. 
• The AIFF's calendar for the 2024-25 season is designed to avoid scheduling conflicts between major tournaments and championships, ensuring maximum participation and viewership. 
• The **Durand Cup** is considered a curtain-raiser for the Indian football season, showcasing top teams and players from across the country. 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Option 1.*** 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Durand Cup:** 
• The Durand Cup is the **oldest football tournament in Asia**, established in **1888**. It is also the third oldest football competition in the world. 
• It is organized by the **Indian Armed Forces** and the AIFF, with participation from top teams in the Indian Super League (ISL), I-League, and Services teams. 
• The tournament serves as a platform for young and emerging players to showcase their talent ahead of the domestic football season. 
• **I-League 3:** 
• The I-League 3 is a newly introduced league by the AIFF aimed at **grassroots development** and providing opportunities for young footballers and clubs across India. 
• It is the third tier of the Indian football league system, below the ISL and I-League. 
• Clubs participating in I-League 3 are required to meet licensing and infrastructure criteria set by the AIFF. 
• **Junior Girls National Football Championship:** 
• This championship is part of AIFF's initiatives to promote **women's football** in India at the grassroots and junior levels. 
• The tournament is divided into **two tiers** to ensure competitive balance and encourage participation from all states and union territories. 
• The top teams from Tier 2 have the opportunity to qualify for Tier 1 in subsequent seasons. 
• **All India Football Federation (AIFF):** 
• The AIFF is the **governing body** for football in India, affiliated with FIFA and the Asian Football Confederation (AFC). 
• It is responsible for organizing domestic football leagues, tournaments, and national team activities. 
• The AIFF's vision includes grassroots development, women's football promotion, and improving India's global football ranking. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **AIFF Calendar:** The calendar for the 2024-25 season has been meticulously planned to avoid overlap between major tournaments, ensuring better organization and participation. 
• **Development Initiatives:** AIFF has introduced multiple leagues and championships to nurture young talent and promote football across all age groups and genders. 
• **Historical Significance:** The Durand Cup holds a special place in Indian football history, attracting fans and players alike with its rich legacy and competitive spirit. </ul
